training_adapter.bank_projection: materialize only exact group_id entries from each frozen manifest; do not expand a selected episode_id to its unselected sibling queries or perturbation groups
training_adapter.eligible_group_rule: train split, not open_world, kind in {choice, independent}; v0.8 ordinal rows are exposed by the adapter as choice-kind softmax rows
training_adapter.invariance_pair_selection: train_groups are ordered by group_id by v0.5 stable_sample; probe.invariant_pairs preserves first-key order, selects the first base row with perturbation_class null and first sibling with perturbation_class surfaceinvariance, then vectorized_invariant_loss uses the first 16 directed base-to-sibling pairs
training_adapter.invariance_pair_loss_inputs: ordered state-query input and ordered candidate-surface arrays for both endpoints, plus adapter kind; gold targets are not consumed by the pair regularizer

fields: name_definition candidate surface strings aligned with float32 target bits
adapter decision kind and query view
probability_source, semantic loss, fixed semantic/Brier coefficients and derived Brier applicability
selected directed invariance-pair context when the v0.5 trainer uses the row
training_signature.choice_permutation_equivalence: supervised signature canonicalizes aligned candidate-surface/float32-target pairs because the head loss and candidate scorer are permutation-equivariant; ordered-surface signature is also reported as a stricter diagnostic
excluded_fields: generator metadata not consumed by the adapter
training_signature.target_precision: IEEE-754 float32 bits, matching the trainer's torch.float32 target tensor
training_signature.equivalence_scope: exact adapter text and loss-input equivalence; different text hashes are counted as distinct even if an unobserved tokenizer or backbone might map them to identical token/features; no tokenizer, model weights, cached embeddings, or model outputs are read in this metadata-only phase
training_signature.invariance_pair_order: reconstructed exactly from the bank's group_id-sorted training rows and frozen v0.5 first-16 selection

distances.training_multiset: same formula over supervised signatures augmented with the exact selected invariance-pair role/event hashes
distances.threshold_interpretation: at least ten percent of 100,000 supervised training mass differs by canonical loss signature; not a model-quality claim

order: CM100 from R100 witness only if RM100 clears every readiness gate

objective.curated_priority: descending global frozen-v0.8 five-axis rarity-weighted coverage score, then ascending SHA256(seed|group_id), then lexical group_id; priority=eligible_count-zero_based_rank
objective.random_priority: ascending SHA256(seed|group_id), then lexical group_id; priority=eligible_count-zero_based_rank

search_policy.constraints: the complete inherited Phase 2 profile contract, independently recomputed after each checkpoint
search_policy.method: witness-seeded deterministic local/large-neighborhood search over atom counts; retain and checkpoint only full-profile-valid incumbents; exact cell counts remain mandatory
search_policy.search_protocol_freeze: a child search receipt must freeze the concrete neighborhood schedule, tie breaks, budget and source hashes after metadata-only mobility analysis and before candidate optimization
search_policy.timeout_semantics: UNKNOWN_BOUNDED_SEARCH; never infer infeasibility or zero headroom

acceptance.factorial_ready: both RM100 and CM100 independently pass every per-bank condition
acceptance.model_run: requires a new explicit model-contact authorization; FACTORIAL_READY does not authorize training
